problemSolution.title: Recording video every week doesn't scale
problemSolution.body: Booking a studio, scheduling a shoot, and editing every video eats up time most teams don't have. eckko.ai trains a digital avatar of you once and generates as many videos as you need from a script — no camera, no studio, no manual editing.

items.q: Do I need to know how to shoot or edit video?
items.a: No. You record your avatar's reference footage once; after that, generating a new video is just writing (or AI-generating) a script.

items.q: Is my data isolated from other customers?
items.a: Yes. Every account is isolated by tenant — one customer's avatars, videos, documents, and credentials are never visible to another.

items.q: Do I need to connect my own AI key?
items.a: No. The avatar, voice, and script integrations are eckko.ai's own — you don't need an account with any provider, and there's no API key to manage. Just pick a plan and go.

items.q: Where are my uploaded files stored?
items.a: You choose between keeping files in your own Google Drive or hosted by eckko.ai, depending on your plan.

items.q: Can I try it before paying?
items.a: Yes, the Free plan lets you create an account and explore the product at no cost.

avatarSetup.scopeNote: This screen sets up your reusable avatar: photos, reference video and voice. It applies to every video you generate with it. What changes from video to video — script, background, performance, outfit and format — lives in the next steps. The virtual background here only affects the avatar PHOTO, to make the face stand out; the video background is chosen in the Scene step.
avatarSetup.noAvatarsYet: No avatars saved yet. Set one up once, then reuse it for every video.
avatarSetup.nameHelp: A short label to recognize this avatar later, e.g. the presenter's name or role.
avatarSetup.nameHelpPrompt: Explain what the 'Avatar name' field on this screen is for and how to choose a good name.
avatarSetup.retrainConfirm: Recording or uploading a new reference video will train this avatar again with the provider — real cost of about US$ 1.00, even if the current training is already done. Continue?
avatarSetup.addLookHelp: This creates a paid Look on HeyGen: a fixed outfit, saved with the provider, used only when the video is generated on the Simple tier. It costs $1.00 (60 units) — charged as soon as the provider accepts the request. It's different from the Normal and Premium tiers' outfit: that one is chosen per video in the Scene step, and it's free and editable at any time.
avatarSetup.lookPromptHelp: Upload an image, describe it in text, or both. A name alone doesn't describe any clothing.
avatarSetup.lookPromptPlaceholder: e.g. navy suit, white shirt, no tie

It was already charged and is not lost: it will show up on its own in the Scene step selector as soon as it's ready, with nothing for you to do. Don't create it again — each outfit is charged separately.

audioTreatment.help: Cleans up and normalizes this avatar's cloned voice before every future video generation — noise reduction plus loudness normalization to the target below.
audioTreatment.targetLufsHelp: Louder (closer to -6) reads punchier; quieter (closer to -24) reads more natural. -16 LUFS is a common streaming-friendly default.

avatarSetup.uploadPhotoHint: You can pick several at once; they fill the slots in the order they are sent.
avatarSetup.deletePhotoHint: Deleting a photo moves the following ones up one slot, and the next photo you capture or upload goes into the last slot. The first photo in the list is the one used as the base image for the avatar.
avatarSetup.recordingCounter: Recording {{elapsed}} of {{max}} — stops on its own in {{remaining}}s.
avatarSetup.recordingShort: {{elapsed}} — still too short to clone the voice. Keep talking for another {{missing}}s to reach {{minimum}}.
avatarSetup.recordingWorkable: {{elapsed}} — enough to clone, with simpler results. Another {{missing}}s up to {{recommended}} improves the likeness noticeably.
avatarSetup.recordingGood: {{elapsed}} — good length for cloning. Stop whenever you like; it stops on its own in {{remaining}}s.
avatarSetup.recordingTooLarge: A {{size}} recording is over the {{max}} limit. Record at 1080p instead of 4K, or record a shorter take.
avatarSetup.recordingTooLong: A {{duration}} recording is over the {{max}} limit. Record a shorter take — the duration covers both the avatar and the voice.
avatarSetup.fileTooLarge: The file is {{size}} and the limit is {{max}}. Record at 1080p instead of 4K — that usually fixes it without shortening the video. If it still exceeds, record a shorter take.
avatarSetup.referenceGuidance: Video preferably at 1080p and 30fps. Up to 100 MB and up to 2 minutes of continuous speech — 30 seconds already works, with simpler results.
avatarSetup.referenceGuidanceEnvironment: Clean, solid neutral-colored background (white, light gray, etc.), with no detail or movement behind you. Natural light, facing a window — avoid backlighting and harsh shadows. Public HeyGen recommendation for higher-quality avatars.
avatarSetup.imageTooLarge: The image is {{size}} and the limit is {{max}}. Reduce the image resolution before uploading, or use a compressed copy instead of the camera original.

voiceTuning.title: Voice tuning
voiceTuning.help: Applies to every video from this avatar, across all three tiers. The starting values are the ones the provider was already applying — changes here only take effect from the next generation on.
voiceTuning.stabilityHelp: Lower varies the intonation more; higher makes delivery more uniform and can sound monotone.
voiceTuning.similarityHelp: Higher tries to match the recording you sent, flaws included; lower smooths it out.
voiceTuning.styleHelp: Exaggerates expressiveness. Above zero, generation gets slower.
voiceTuning.speakerBoostHelp: Speaker boost: improves similarity to the speaker at some processing cost. On by default.

heygenVoiceTuning.title: Voice tuning (HeyGen)
heygenVoiceTuning.help: This voice was cloned directly on HeyGen — the available controls are different. They only apply when this avatar generates on the Simple tier.
heygenVoiceTuning.pitchHelp: Fine pitch adjustment, in semitones. Small adjustments (±5 to ±15) shift perceived age and tone without sounding processed.
heygenVoiceTuning.volumeHelp: Voice audio level. Most useful when mixing with background music or effects.
heygenVoiceTuning.localeHelp: Code in pt-BR, en-US format, etc. — only for multilingual voices. Leave blank for the default.

voiceSample.title: Avatar voice
voiceSample.hint: Record speaking continuously, with no cuts or long pauses. The provider learns the pace of whatever audio you send: a choppy or rushed sample produces a voice that speaks too fast. Sit somewhere without echo, keep the same distance from the microphone throughout, and speak as if you were presenting. Aim close to {{max}}, not to the minimum: the floor is {{min}} and from {{recommended}} on the result improves, but the more continuous speech, the better the clone. Beyond {{max}} the sample no longer fits the upload to the voice provider.
voiceSample.alreadyCloned: This avatar already has a cloned voice. Sending another sample replaces the current one, and the previous voice cannot be recovered.
voiceSample.listenFirst: Listen before sending — once cloned, the voice uses a slot that cannot be given back.
voiceSample.tooShort: too short — {{missing}}s to go before the minimum
voiceSample.workable: long enough to clone — {{missing}}s to go before the recommended length
voiceSample.blockedShort: The sample needs to be at least {{min}}.
voiceSample.cloned: Voice cloned. The account now has {{used}} of {{limit}} voices in use.
voiceSample.slotsDeclaredNote: Cap declared by this app, not confirmed with the provider in this reading.

result.created: Voice created and linked to this avatar · {{used}} of {{limit}} slots used
result.cloneAgainWarning: Cloning again creates a NEW voice and burns another irreversible slot. The current voice stays in the provider account and is not deleted — this product does not delete voices.

voiceSample.replaceExplain: Confirming replaces this avatar's current voice with a new one. The previous voice stays in the provider account, but is no longer linked to this avatar here.
voiceSample.protectedExplain: This is the voice from the already-approved video and it is protected. The old one does not come back: the product does not delete voices at the provider, its slot is not freed, and the avatar keeps a single id. If this is really what you want, type the avatar name to confirm: {{name}}
voiceSample.protectedInputLabel: Avatar name, to confirm replacing the protected voice
voiceSample.micDenied: The browser blocked the microphone. Allow microphone access for this site and try again, or upload an audio file.
voiceSample.micUnavailable: Could not access the microphone. Check that a microphone is connected, or upload an audio file.
voiceSample.genericError: Could not complete the operation. Please try again in a moment.
voiceSample.scope: This voice belongs to the avatar, not to this video: replacing it changes every video you generate with it from now on. Already-generated videos keep the old voice.
voiceSample.removeNoiseHelp: Only tick this if you recorded somewhere noisy. The cleanup is destructive and can strip part of the timbre along with the noise — on an already quiet recording it has only downside.
voiceSample.fileMaxSize: Files up to {{size}}. Anything larger is refused before conversion.

scene.scenarioHelp: Upload an image or describe it by text. Starts pre-filled with the avatar's saved scenario (Step 1), when there is one — freely editable from here, for this video only.
scene.scenarioPromptPlaceholder: describe the scenario: bright blurred doctor's office, modern office, plain studio backdrop…
scene.outfitHelp: Upload an image or describe it by text. Starts pre-filled with the avatar's saved outfit (Step 1), when there is one — freely editable from here, for this video only.
scene.outfitPromptPlaceholder: describe the outfit: buttoned white lab coat, navy suit, dress shirt…
scene.backgroundHelp: Pick a solid colour or upload an image. With no choice, the vendor keeps the background from the avatar photo.
scene.backgroundNotImage: That file is not an image. Upload JPG, PNG or WebP.
scene.backgroundNoVideo: Video backgrounds are not available: the video service accepts colour and image only.
scene.backgroundTierNotice: Background only applies to the Simple tier (HeyGen) — Normal/Premium generate the background as part of the composed image instead.
scene.motionHelp: Describe how the person should move and express themselves while narrating.
scene.motionHelpPrompt: One idea per line tends to work best: body part, action and emotion. For example, “open hands at chest height, calm gesture”.
scene.motionPlaceholder:
open hands at chest height, calm gesture
look straight at the camera, light smile
scene.motionOurAdvice: This writing guidance is our recommendation, not the video service’s: it accepts free text and publishes a single example, with no formatting rules.
scene.motionCameraLimit: Camera or scene directions — "walks toward the camera", "steps back", "the camera moves closer" — are never honored: this field only controls the person's body, hands, and expression, never the camera or the setting.
scene.expressivenessHelp: How much the face and body follow the speech. Set to "Medium" by default — switch to Low or High whenever you like.
scene.lookHelp: Which look of the avatar goes into this video.
scene.lookSingle: This avatar has a single look. Looks are created on the avatar, not on the video — each new outfit is a variation saved with it.
